answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and tie that stake to a verifiable history of completed work rather than a free account. Creating ten thousand fake identities then means funding ten thousand deposits and building ten thousand track records, which turns a cheap flood into an expensive investment. Like a lantern lit in a dark ocean, one genuine record stands out: an opal-grade reputation earned over time cannot be copied by minting new keys, so sybils lose money if they misbehave and honest agents keep their stake.
